Several hours (No Rest for the Wicked Quest) and then several Arbaziloth kills for the addons (depends on drop luck)

The {wiki:Fiend Slayer Outfits|Fiend Slayer Outfits} are earned in Azzilon, the fortress island reached through {npc:Fernlor}'s teleport in Edron. The base outfit is the final reward of the {wiki:No Rest for the Wicked Quest}; the two addons come from the boss {creature:Arbaziloth}: the {item:Demon Claws} drop when you kill it in **easy mode** and the {item:Demon Skull} when you kill it in **hard mode**. With both addons you earn the achievement **Fiend Slayer**.

A powerful boss called Arbaziloth lurks in the depths of Azzilon, guarding powerful items and spreading chaos upon anyone who dares to enter his domain. Only the bravest adventurers survive the trials of this dangerous quest.

Loot from {creature:Arbaziloth} (500,000 experience): {wiki:Inferniarch Set|Inferniarch Set} weapons in easy mode; {item:Demonfang Mask}, {item:Dreadfire Headpiece}, {item:Hellstalker Visor}, {item:Maliceforged Helmet}, {item:Demon Mengu} and {item:Demon in a Green Box} (Primal Demonosaur mount) in hard mode

Addons 1 and 2 of the Fiend Slayer Outfits
By using the {item:Demon Claws} (addon 1) and the {item:Demon Skull} (addon 2), once you already have the base outfit from the {wiki:No Rest for the Wicked Quest}.
Both items can be bought on the Market.
After killing {creature:Arbaziloth} in **hard mode** (sparing {creature:The Forgemaster (Creature)|The Forgemaster}), use the orange teleport in the boss room.
After 10 wins in hard mode an extra Doomforge room opens where you choose the base version of an Inferniarch Set weapon.
The {item:Demon Claws} and the {item:Demon Skull} are stackable and **sell on the Market**: if you don't want to (or can't) kill Arbaziloth, buy them from other players and use them.

The fight mode decides the loot: killing {creature:The Forgemaster (Creature)|The Forgemaster} = easy mode (can drop the Demon Claws); sparing her = hard mode (can drop the Demon Skull). For both addons you need to win at least once in each mode (or buy the items on the Market).
Bring protection against **death** and **energy**, and against **life drain** for the demons and the Forgemaster.

{creature:Arbaziloth} has 360,000 health and takes 100% holy and earth damage (probably energy too), 85% fire, 80% ice and death and only 70% physical damage. It cannot be paralysed, sees through invisibility, attacks in melee and can cause **Powerless**.
Since the update of 25 February 2025, Arbaziloth is no longer affected by Damage Reflection.
Each player must bring their own {item:Fishing Rod}: without rods there is no way to make the boss vulnerable.

Everything takes place in Azzilon, a forgotten fortress island to the east, linked to Edron by a teleport from {npc:Fernlor}. You will take this route for No Rest for the Wicked and every time you want to try Arbaziloth.
Take a boat to **Edron** from one of the main ports, for example with {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}. You arrive at Edron harbour, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}.

From the harbour, walk **south-east** to the ivory towers in the **eastern** part of Edron: this is the {wiki:Noodles Academy of Modern Magic|Noodles Academy of Modern Magic}. {npc:Fernlor} is on the **underground floor (-1)**, next to the orange teleport to Azzilon.

The first time, say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. Fernlor, High Scryer of the Arcane Academy, has found a disturbance on a remote island to the east and set up a teleport there. This is the start of the {wiki:No Rest for the Wicked Quest}.
Step into the **orange teleport** next to Fernlor. You arrive at {wiki:Azzilon Castle|Azzilon Castle}. Go down the stairs and up another set to enter the castle.

Inside the castle, keep heading **north** to the **south-east inner tower**. Climb the tower to the **3rd floor above ground**: {npc:Lai} is in the centre of that floor. She gives the No Rest for the Wicked missions and hands you the base outfit at the end.
The base outfit is **not** earned in this quest: it is the final reward of the {wiki:No Rest for the Wicked Quest}. Summary of the missions (that quest's guide has all the details):
Ask {npc:Lai} for a {key:mission} after each stage. The order is:
Talk to {npc:Fernlor} in Edron and go through the teleport to {npc:Lai}.
Hand in 100 {item:Demonic Core Essence|Demonic Core Essences} to Lai ({key:essences}). From then on you gain ranks against the corruption of the catacombs and the catacombs are open to you.
Activate the ancient crystals of the castle's four towers: start with the **north-west** one and activate the other three before the first runs out of energy.
On floor -1, to the **south-east**, enter the teleport and talk to {npc:Ortelio} ({key:out}, {key:open}).
Loot {item:Mummified Demon Finger|Mummified Demon Fingers} and use them on Ortelio's cell door until you are teleported inside.
Accept Lai's attunement, say {key:hi} to {npc:A Vision of the Past} and go back through the portal to the south.
On floor -2, feed {creature:Hungry Slave Troll|Hungry Slave Trolls} with {item:Some Troll Food} until 20 reach the green portal (10 min, lever for 5).
Kill 25 {creature:Charged Imp|Charged Imps} without letting the {creature:Powercollector} counter reach 25 (10 min, lever for 5).
On floor -2, enter the fishing task teleport and fish 25 **Energy Spheres** with the {item:Fishing Rod} (message *"GOT ONE!"* for each one).
After defeating {creature:Arbaziloth} for the first time, go back to {npc:Lai} and report the {key:mission} one last time. You receive the base {wiki:Fiend Slayer Outfits|Fiend Slayer Outfit}.
Both addons only drop from {creature:Arbaziloth}, the final boss of No Rest for the Wicked. You can fight it again to try for the drops.

Gather your team (the tasks in this part of the quest use a lever for **up to 5 players**; the more, the better). **Each player** brings a {item:Fishing Rod}. Bring protection against **death** and **energy**, and against **life drain** for the demons and the Forgemaster.
Don't forget the {item:Fishing Rod}! Without it you cannot make Arbaziloth vulnerable.

From the castle, go down to the {wiki:Azzilon Catacombs|Azzilon Catacombs} and keep going down to **floor -3**. On the underground floors you take **Agony Damage** every 20 seconds, calculated on your current health (e.g. rank 1 with 10,000 health = 450 damage). The damage drops with your rank with Lai (essences handed in):
Access to the last floor of the catacombs

After the first hand-in to Lai you can use the {item:Demonic Core Essence|Demonic Core Essences} yourself, without going back to her, to rank up. Note **rank 5** (1,600 essences): it is what gives access to the last floor of the catacombs.

The monsters on the deeper floors are stronger: {creature:Brinebrute Inferniarch|Brinebrute Inferniarchs}, {creature:Hellhunter Inferniarch|Hellhunter Inferniarchs}, {creature:Spellreaper Inferniarch|Spellreaper Inferniarchs} and other Inferniarchs.
On **floor -3**, use the portal to {creature:Arbaziloth}'s lair. Inside are Arbaziloth, two {creature:Overcharged Demon|Overcharged Demons} and {creature:The Forgemaster (Creature)|The Forgemaster}.
The Forgemaster is there so you can decide which fight you want. The mode decides the loot, and therefore which addon can drop:
Kill {creature:The Forgemaster (Creature)|The Forgemaster} during the fight
Arbaziloth does not heal at the end; no access to the Doomforge
After the 4th mechanic the Forgemaster leaves, Arbaziloth heals fully and hits harder

{item:Demonfang Mask}, {item:Dreadfire Headpiece}, {item:Hellstalker Visor}, {item:Maliceforged Helmet}, {item:Demon Mengu}, {item:Demon Skull} (**addon 2**), {item:Demon in a Green Box} and access to the {wiki:Doomforge|Doomforge}

The two {creature:Overcharged Demon|Overcharged Demons} respawn every time they die, and **each one you kill heals Arbaziloth**. Two common strategies: lure them far away in the room until they lose their target, or have a player who is not the main blocker hold them.
Don't kill the Overcharged Demons: you are only healing the boss.

Attack {creature:Arbaziloth}. At **four** points in the fight it shouts *"Open fire you fools!"* and becomes **invulnerable**: it still takes damage, but its health doesn't go down. The {creature:Imp Minion|Imp Minions} fire the slingshot and a **purple fire field** appears at a random spot in the room.
Watch for the message: while it is invulnerable, you are wasting supplies.
Pull the boss onto the purple fire
The blocker takes Arbaziloth onto the purple fire field and keeps it there until you hear *"CRAAAACK!"*.
Use the Fishing Rods on the boss

Right after the *"CRAAAACK!"*, **everyone** uses their {item:Fishing Rod} on Arbaziloth to make it vulnerable again. It can dodge a rod (Ruse/Dodge effect), so it is best if the whole team uses one. When it works, a hearts effect appears on the boss, everyone loses their target and it loses one of the energy spheres on its arm. What it shouts tells you which round you are on:
After each round you have to target the boss again.

If you want the {item:Demon Claws} (addon 1), kill {creature:The Forgemaster (Creature)|The Forgemaster} during the fight. That way Arbaziloth **does not heal** at the end; carry on through the four rounds of the mechanic and kill it.
If the Forgemaster dies, the Doomforge is not accessible on that kill.

If you want the {item:Demon Skull} (addon 2), do **not** attack the Forgemaster. Shortly after the 4th mechanic she leaves the fight and Arbaziloth **heals fully**. There are no more mechanics: just attack it until it dies, but in this phase it deals **more damage**.
Save supplies for this final phase: the boss returns to full health and hits harder.

Open Arbaziloth's corpse (500,000 experience). Besides money, potions and gems, look for the addon item the mode allows: {item:Demon Claws} in easy mode, {item:Demon Skull} in hard mode. The wiki has no drop rate for the Demon Claws and, in the statistics it does have (only 38 kills, both modes combined), the Demon Skull dropped once (2.6%): expect several attempts.
Arbaziloth's loot (Demon Claws in easy mode / Demon Skull in hard mode, if you're lucky)

If you spared the Forgemaster, use the room's **orange teleport** to enter the {wiki:Doomforge|Doomforge}. There, {npc:The Forgemaster} exchanges a base weapon from the {wiki:Inferniarch Set|Inferniarch Set} and various creature products for an upgraded version (Rending, Siphoning or Draining).
After **10 hard mode wins** you gain access to an extra Doomforge room where you can take the base version of any Inferniarch Set weapon.

The wiki doesn't describe the exit from the boss room or the return from Azzilon to Edron. Go back the way you came: climb the catacomb floors by the same stairs up to the castle and return to the spot where {npc:Fernlor}'s teleport dropped you. If you get stuck, a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} takes you to your temple (it doesn't work in No-Logout zones or while you have a Logout Block or Protection Zone Block). In Edron, take the boat at {npc:Captain Seahorse}'s harbour to return to your city.
While you are on the underground floors you keep taking Agony Damage every 20 seconds: don't stand around down there on low health.

The {item:Demon Claws} drop from {creature:Arbaziloth} **only when you kill it in easy mode** (by killing the Forgemaster). You can also buy them on the **Market** from other players; no NPC sells them.
With the base outfit already unlocked, use the {item:Demon Claws}. A bite animation appears and you receive the **first addon**.
If you don't have the base outfit yet, you get *"You don't own the Fiend Slayer outfit yet."*: finish the No Rest for the Wicked Quest first.
Addon 1 of the Fiend Slayer Outfits
The {item:Demon Skull} drops from {creature:Arbaziloth} **only when you kill it in hard mode** (by sparing the Forgemaster). You can also buy it on the **Market**; no NPC sells it.
With the base outfit already unlocked, use the {item:Demon Skull}. A bite animation appears and you receive the **second addon**.
Addon 2 of the Fiend Slayer Outfits
As soon as you have **both addons** you receive the achievement **Fiend Slayer** (2 points): *"No living fiends were hurt to achieve this outfit."*
Male Fiend Slayer with both addons
Female Fiend Slayer with both addons
The addons can be obtained in any order: you just need to have the base outfit before using each item.

The Azzilon catacombs depend on a world change: they are blocked by a mist until the players on the world hand in enough essences to Lai. When that happens, the server message *"The mists in Azzilon have retreated!"* appears.
Arbaziloth's loot table changes depending on the fight mode: the Demon Claws only exist in easy mode and the Demon Skull only in hard mode.
